headline: Oil Prices Stabilise as Traders Assess US Crude Stockpile Draw and Mideast Votes
summary: Crude oil held recent declines as market participants evaluated an API-reported 2-million-barrel drop in US inventories alongside geopolitical developments from Israeli parliamentary elections.
why: Global crude benchmark prices directly influence international refining margins, airline operating expenditures, and headline sovereign inflation prints.

impacts.name: Crude Oil
impacts.why: US inventory draws provide price support against broader geopolitical demand uncertainty.
